_context.back: Screen reader label of the arrow that goes back to the previous panel.
_context.deleteConfirmTitle: Default title of a delete confirmation. {label} is the label of the delete button, such as 'Delete skill'.
_context.filter.search: Placeholder of the search field of a filter. {label} is the name of the filter in lower case, such as 'status'.
_context.combobox.selected: Heading of the group listing the options already picked.
_context.combobox.reorder: Screen reader label of the handle that drags an option to change its order. {option} is the option.
_context.powerBars: Screen reader label of a row of bars rating how capable an AI model is.
_context.phone.code: Screen reader label of the field that holds the country calling code, such as +33.
_context.upload.waiting: Status of a file waiting its turn to upload. {size} is its size, already formatted.
_context.upload.more: Button that shows the rest of the upload list. {count} is the number of rows still hidden.
_context.markdown.done: Button that closes the full markdown editor and keeps the text.
_context.waveform.idle: Screen reader label of a flat audio waveform while nothing is recorded.
